welcome:
Welcome to the HashiCorp Vault CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated Vault server.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check that Vault is running and unsealed.
Enable the KV version 2 secrets engine at the path 'secret/'.
Store the database credentials for the payments service.
steps.expect: vault kv put secret/payments/db username=payments_svc password=S3cur3P@ss!2026
steps.hint: Try: vault kv put secret/payments/db username=payments_svc password=S3cur3P@ss!2026

steps.instruction: Read back the credentials to verify they were stored correctly.
Rotate the password by writing a new version of the secret.
steps.expect: vault kv put secret/payments/db username=payments_svc password=R0tated#NewP@ss!2026
steps.hint: Try: vault kv put secret/payments/db username=payments_svc password=R0tated#NewP@ss!2026

steps.instruction: Check the metadata to see both versions are tracked.
steps.hint: Try: vault kv metadata get secret/payments/db

steps.instruction: Create a policy that gives the payments service read-only access to its secrets.
Verify the policy was created by listing all policies.
Vault has just restarted. Check its current seal status.
Vault is sealed. Begin unsealing with the first key share.
Continue unsealing with the second key share.
Provide the third and final key share to complete the unseal.
Verify Vault is now unsealed and operational.
Check which audit devices are enabled to confirm logging is active.
Check the Raft cluster peers to confirm all nodes are healthy.
Authenticate with the root token to resume operations.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  vault status                   — Show seal status and cluster info
  vault operator unseal          — Unseal Vault with a key share
  vault operator seal            — Seal the Vault
  vault operator init            — Initialize a new Vault cluster
  vault operator raft list-peers — List Raft cluster members
  vault secrets list             — List enabled secrets engines
  vault secrets enable           — Enable a secrets engine
  vault secrets disable          — Disable a secrets engine
  vault kv put                   — Write a secret
  vault kv get                   — Read a secret
  vault kv list                  — List secrets at a path
  vault kv delete                — Delete a secret version
  vault kv metadata get          — Get secret metadata/versions
  vault kv rollback              — Roll back to a previous version
  vault auth list                — List enabled auth methods
  vault auth enable              — Enable an auth method
  vault login                    — Authenticate to Vault
  vault token lookup             — Inspect current token
  vault token create             — Create a new token
  vault token revoke             — Revoke a token
  vault policy list              — List policies
  vault policy read              — Read a policy
  vault policy write             — Write a policy
  vault policy delete            — Delete a policy
  vault audit list               — List enabled audit devices
  vault audit enable             — Enable an audit device
  vault lease list               — List active leases
  vault lease renew              — Renew a lease
  vault lease revoke             — Revoke a lease
  vault server -dev              — Start in development mode

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help
